thread:
elaine-sales: quick heads up — acme bank POC: they want a short dataflow + answers for subprocessor access and KMS ownership. they specifically asked for per-tenant CMK option, tamper-evident access logs for any human/manual accesses, and confirmation of what metadata we persist. can we turn a one-pager + diagram and an FAQ by EOD?

tyler-se: short answers first — we support customer-managed keys for Private and Dedicated (BYOK). hosted API currently only uses our KMS; we can offer encryption-at-rest and envelope keys but not CMK for hosted.

jessica-arch: attaching a quick sketch here in text form, will make a nicer SVG after we confirm bits:

jessica-arch: ```
Client (VPC) -> Private CP / Dedicated Endpoint -> L7 Router -> Inference Pool (GPU hosts)
                      |-> KMS (customer-managed if Private/Dedicated BYOK)
                      |-> KV cache (encrypted)
Audit pipeline: inference logs -> immutable audit store (WORM) -> SIEM / Customer S3 (signed bundles)
Notes: plaintext inputs are not stored by default; outputs persisted only if customer enables retention.
```

maria-security: clarifying details: we do not persist full plaintext customer inputs by default. stored metadata = [request_id, model_version, timestamp, token_counts, route]. logs of control-plane actions and subprocessor human accesses are logged with user, action, timestamp, and justification. we can HMAC the log bundles and ship signed evidence.

raj-legal: acme asked for a subprocessor attestation and an on-demand evidence package (signed) for any access events. can we commit to monthly subproc list + ad-hoc evidence within 72 hours?

jessica-arch: for Dedicated: we can provide current subprocessor list + monthly updates and detailed logs. for Private (customer-managed deployment) there are no Redwood subprocessors touching customer data; we can provide that statement and help with on-prem package.

infra-ops: confirm KMS modes — Dedicated supports customer BYOK via KMS integration (we store only wrapped keys). Private supports full customer-controlled KMS/HSM. Hosted API uses Redwood KMS; we can offer tokenization and field-level encryption per contract. retention windows configurable per-customer up to contract limits.

elaine-sales: perfect. acme also wants to know whether the inference cache or prompt prefix cache might leak tenant data between customers. short answer?

maria-security: caches are namespaced by tenant id and encrypted at rest. runtime KV cache uses per-tenant namespaces and is zeroed on model re-load or scale-down events. any cache dumps used for debugging are redacted and require infra + security approval; exports are auditable.

tyler-se: i'll draft the one-pager and a simple diagram. plan:
- one-page overview (KMS modes, dataflow, retention, audit)
- succinct answers to: CMK support, metadata retention, cache isolation, subproc attestations, SOC2/SIG status, evidence turnaround SLA
- attach current subprocessor list and contact info

raj-legal: please add a short commitment statement about not sharing raw customer data with subprocessors except as necessary for managed services, and that we will provide signed access logs on request. legal ok to promise 72-hour evidence turnaround for enterprise contracts (subject to scope).

deploy-bot: New POC request created: POC-ACME-149 assigned to tyler-se — https://redwood.internal/ops/pocs/POC-ACME-149

tyler-se: noted. @jessica-arch can you export the diagram as SVG once i post the draft? i'll also ping security for the signed audit bundle example.

jessica-arch: yes, will export. can we get a sample of the audit bundle format to include? json + detached signature is fine.

maria-security: sample bundle = {"events": [...], "sig": "..."} — we can provide a 2-line example and the verification steps. also include retention policy options: default 90d, enterprise up to 7y with contract clause.

elaine-sales: acme's deadline for initial artifact is EOD tomorrow. tyler — can you confirm ETA here when you have 1st draft?

tyler-se: ETA tomorrow 1500 PT for draft. i'll cc raj and maria.

raj-legal: will review the commitment wording after draft.

elaine-sales: awesome — thanks team :thumbsup:

tyler-se: assigning checklist to self: 1) one-pager 2) diagram SVG 3) subproc list 4) sample signed audit bundle 5) brief SIG/SOC2 status note. will drop everything in the POC-ACME-149 thread link.

deploy-bot: POC-ACME-149 updated: files uploaded by tyler-se (one-pager v0.1, architecture-sketch.svg v0.1)

elaine-sales: solid. looping in acme-main contact once we have final artifacts. thanks all.
